mostWorthwhile.text: Marking the lit market on Moth's map connected the repair work to the story's central problem: a directory can omit places that plainly exist.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the sheltered lights directly with the battery led to a dead end without explaining what preparation was missing.

surprise.text: Inspecting the lamp revealed that fitting the reflector also fixed its loose joint; I had expected the joint to need a separate tool repair.

arbitrary.text: The lamp's joint repair being bundled with the reflector fitting was not obvious from the available names, although the result explained what happened.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see whether the marked map can challenge the directory, and the practical repairs made that larger problem feel tangible.
